investigation.title: image-generation-stream Eval Failure: OpenAI API Credit Balance Exhausted
investigation.summary: The image-generation-stream eval failed because the OpenAI API key used by the eval runner has no remaining credits, causing the upstream API to return a credit_balance_exhausted error. This terminated the SSE stream with a generation_error frame instead of the required generation_completed frame, so both contract assertions failed: frameTypes did not contain "generation_completed" and imageUrlPresent remained false.
investigation.rootCause: The OpenAI organization account associated with the API key used by the eval runner at /api/generate/image/stream has exhausted its credit balance. The OpenAI API rejected the image generation request with error type "insufficient_quota" and code "credit_balance_exhausted" before any image could be produced. This is an external billing/quota condition, not a code defect in the eval runner or the application stream routing logic. The eval itself is functioning correctly: it reached the endpoint, received a well-formed SSE stream, and accurately recorded the generation_error frame. The failure is localized to this eval's dependency on a funded OpenAI API key and does not indicate a user-facing product outage unless the same depleted key is used in production traffic (no such evidence is present in this packet).
proof: failed-check.message: OpenAI error code 'credit_balance_exhausted' with message 'You have no credits remaining. Add credits to continue using the API at https://platform.openai.com/settings/organization/billing/.' is present verbatim in the generation_error frame and in the top-level check failure message.

failed-check.evidence: The SSE frame sequence is [generation_start, generation_start, generation_progress, generation_error, message]. The generation_error frame carries GENERATION_FAILED with the OpenAI quota error. No generation_completed frame was emitted.
failed-check.evidence: imageUrlPresent=false, consistent with the stream terminating on error before any artifact URL could be produced.
failed-check.timing: latencyMs=1455, far below the warningLatencyMs of 180000, confirming the request was rejected almost immediately by the upstream API rather than timing out or hanging.

expected-output.contract: The contract requires frameTypes to contain 'generation_completed' and imageUrlPresent to equal true (check-expectations.json lines 343-344). Both assertions failed because the upstream API rejected the request before generation could complete.

source-context.infra/evals/status/run-status-probes.mjs:1978-1986: The runner calls /api/generate/image/stream with model defaulting to 'gpt-image-2' (process.env.AURA_STATUS_IMAGE_MODEL || 'gpt-image-2'), confirming the OpenAI model and endpoint targeted by this eval.
possibleCauses: Primary (high confidence): The OpenAI organization billing account linked to the API key used by the eval runner has a zero or negative credit balance. The API returned credit_balance_exhausted, which is a deterministic billing rejection, not a transient error.

Secondary (low confidence): The eval runner is using a different OpenAI API key or organization than intended (e.g., a test/sandbox key with a separate quota), and that key's quota is exhausted while a production key may still have credits. This would be confirmed or ruled out by inspecting which key is configured in the eval environment.

Tertiary (very low confidence): A misconfigured AURA_STATUS_IMAGE_MODEL environment variable is causing the request to target a model or endpoint that consumes credits from a different quota bucket, though the error message is explicit about the billing account having no credits remaining.
